$comment: Complete operator briefs filed with --operatorTask are stamped prepared at filing only after the shared prepare section validator plus Done when/Acceptance, Edge cases and we:-qualified scope checks. Cascade: standard enabled=true → platform build.operatorTask → tool build.operatorTask. Each leaf source is logged by policy-cascade. Disabled filing leaves the card unstamped. Post-build steps require operatorTask: true, enabled=true, an enabled policy leaf and the corresponding card field. Edge-load and live-proof steps are off for every card (planOperatorPostBuild never emits them); only the report step is composed. Verified operator-task authority (an operator instruction record, an explicit P0, prepare and queue admission) is card #xqqmw6g. edgeClones maps allowlisted names to workspace-relative or ~/ paths.
